alert.description: TLS alert code observed by the source.

client-cipher.description: One client-advertised cipher suite per attribute.

handshake-duration-ms.description: Handshake duration in milliseconds after TCP establishment, including source-observed client delays.

ja3.description: Client JA3 MD5 fingerprint; populate only when the source fingerprint algorithm is MD5.

ja3s.description: Server JA3S MD5 fingerprint; populate only when the source fingerprint algorithm is MD5.

key-length.description: Negotiated encryption key length in bits.

server-cipher.description: One server-advertised cipher suite per attribute.

server-name.description: SNI hostname sent by the client; omit this typed field when the source value is not a hostname.

description: Negotiated TLS session properties, including protocol, cipher, server name and handshake observations. Reference certificates and network flows separately. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/tls.
name: tls-session
